posts.text:
Thanks for
Tuning in.


Jason Overman (@JasonOverman93)

You're a great journalist, don't let the haters get to you! I watch you every night. You're always fair, balanced, and unafraid! Great show Bret



— https://nitter.net/JasonOverman93/status/2039837056029937948#m

Which democratic or left leaning panelist do you prefer?   Read the room - balance.


madbeachin (@madbeachinit)

@BretBaier seriously?!!  Cuomo’s advisor?  WTF do we need to hear from her?  Read the room!!!



— https://nitter.net/madbeachinit/status/2039839866813374974#m

The anonymous source said there is no bad blood.  And the vanity fair article was a direct quote from the White House chief of staff - but thanks.


Lilly McKim 🇺🇸🐊 (@lillymckim)

So #BretBaier this is as low as you get @BretBaier using #anonymous sources & #VanityFair to talk trash  about #PamBondi



— https://nitter.net/lillymckim/status/2039840349053420016#m

Thanks for watching.  I appreciate the critique.  Will work on it.


BlueLine1982 (@DojutrekMarcie)

What's with the weird looks Bret? you squint your eyes and tilt your head like you're some kind of savant... But it makes you look like a moron... You are NOT fair and balanced...



— https://nitter.net/DojutrekMarcie/status/2039833813690310945#m

Thanks Stoic Plumber — I knew it was from the nasa feed and cgi — I wanted my astronaut guest to explain it to the audience.  “Tell folks where this image comes from.”   But thanks so much for watching.


The Stoic Plumber (@thestoicplumber)

I’m watching faux news for this Artemis deal.

Bret Baier just asked where the camera is that’s capturing a CGI image😆

The guest had to explain it was cgi from nasa 😆😂🤣

🤦🏼



— https://nitter.net/thestoicplumber/status/2039475077654417723#m
Tonight I was joined by Kevin Book, managing director of Clearview Energy partners and he shared his thoughts on the rising costs of gas due to the conflict in Iran #specialreport #gas #energy
Artemis II is now on its way to the Moon, marking a major step in NASA’s return to deep space exploration  #atremis #nasa #space #astronaut
“We were within 15 seconds of calling an abort.” Apollo astronaut Brig Gen Charles Duke reflects on the pressure inside Mission Control during the Moon landing #specialreport

I have had the great privilege to interview a lot of Presidents over the years. Lots of people always wondering what my process is when it comes to interviewing such prominent political figures. Thank you to @Fox News for the look back  #interview #news #obama
Thank you all for sending in your questions today for #tiktoktuesday
Beautiful day here in DC ☀️covering a lot tonight so be sure to stay tuned at 6PM ET on @Fox News
It’s Tuesday you know what that means, leave your questions in the comments or stitch this video with a question and post it and we will answer it live on air tonight on #specialreport #tiktoktuesday
Special shout out tonight to #greenberetbob for your service and support. @Fitz On Everything condolences and blessings to you and your entire family 💛💚
Pakistan’s anbassador to the U.S. says multiple channels are being used to facilitate dialogue with Iran, as efforts continue to create conditions for talks.  #specialreport #fyp #news
@Fitz On Everything thank you to your dad and you for all the support. May your father rest in peace and prayers to your family #greenbaretbob
